Class AddMenuToppingController

java.lang.Object
controller.AddMenuToppingController
public class AddMenuToppingController extends Object
Controller for adding, editing, and deleting menu toppings We keep this separate from the AddMenuDrinkController because toppings are simpler and don't have ingredients or types. Everything here uses similar logic to the AddEmployeeController, but with fewer fields and no ingredient selection.
